parameter_refs.range_or_domain: stand or park by independent activity review

quote: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus, shall: Not stand or park such vehicle upon any street at any place other than a bus stop, bus stand or the origin or destination point for the route to which such vehicle is assigned which has been designated in accordance with Section 11.60.010 [DEF-LVMC-11-60-010] of this Chapter.

activation.condition: Covered operator of non-tour bus stands or parks upon a public street; original status and assigned route reviewed.

obligation.description: Do not stand or park on the street except at officially designated bus stop, bus stand, or assigned-route origin/destination designated under Section 11.60.010.

timing.description: Evaluate full independently reviewed standing or parking activity and Native body position, not one frame.
